title: Black mass payables slump as lithium and nickel prices fall
text: Payables for nickel-cobalt-manganese black mass in Europe fell from around 75% of contained metal value in 2023 to about 55% in late 2024, as lithium carbonate prices dropped more than 70% from their 2022 peak. Recyclers that earn most of their income from selling recovered material saw revenue fall in 2024 even as tonnages grew; service-fee models were more stable.
